author: Sebastian Burke
title: Ten Vikings inducted into Chi Alpha Sigma Honor Society - NewsBreak
text:
By Sebastian Burke ,
5 hours ago Elizabeth City State University recognized the academic and athletic excellence of its student-athletes during the fourth annual induction ceremony of the Chi Alpha Sigma–National College Athlete Honor Society, Tuesday, April 21, in the G.R. Little Theater.
ECSU’s 2026 inductees represent multiple programs, with each student demonstrating a commitment to scholarship, leadership and service: Jade Pugh (cheer, tennis), Jasmine Jackson (women’s basketball), Toriono Combs (football), Trinity Smith (women’s basketball), Edrith Gatling Jr. (football) Kailyn Young (women’s basketball), Jasmine Burks (bowling), M. Renner (tennis), Darius Satterfield (football) and Janiah Beach (cheer).
Founded in 1996 by former DePauw University head football coach Nick Mourouzis, Chi Alpha Sigma is the first and only nonprofit established to honor four-year college student-athletes who excel both in the classroom and in competition. The organization continues to connect outstanding student-athletes through a lifelong network that celebrates their dedication to academic and athletic success.
The ceremony marked the fourth class of Chi Alpha Sigma inductees at ECSU and continued the university’s tradition of celebrating student-athletes who exemplify excellence in all areas of collegiate life.
Family members, faculty, staff and supporters were in attendance to honor the inductees and to recognize their accomplishments both on campus and within their respective sports.
